issue.title: Bug: sonic-yang-mgmt uses clause evaluation ignores leaf-list and refine

failure.body:
### Is it platform specific

generic

### Importance or Severity

Critical

### Description of the bug

Any yang model which has a leaf-list inside a grouping (thus referenced by a uses clause), or when the refine clause is specified with a uses is not properly recognized.

The most obvious way this can be seen is when trying to use a route map within bgp which will cause a yang validation failure due to it ignoring the leaf-list.

The sonic-yang-mgmt code needs to be refactored to fully support uses clause evaluation.

### Steps to Reproduce

Having route maps in BGP NEIGHBORS will fail yang validation
```
"BGP_NEIGHBOR_AF": {
    "default|<IP>|ipv4_unicast": {
        "route_map_in": [ "map1" ],
        "route_map_out": [ "map1" ]
    }
}
```

### Actual Behavior and Expected Behavior

yang validation should succeed.

resolution.title: YANG: remove uses clause handling, now part of sonic-yang-mgmt
resolution.description:
#### What I did

sonic-yang-mgmt now integrates uses clauses as if a uses clause didn't exist. No need to have this complex handling in sonic-utilities.

Depends on https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-buildimage/pull/21907
Fixes https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-buildimage/issues/22382

#### How I did it

Besides removal of the code, the only test case changes are the removal of the 'grouping' clause as it is specific to 'uses' which is not relevant and some minor reordering of expected responses.

#### How to verify it

Run `tests/cli_autogen_yang_parser_test.py` after applying both this PR and https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-buildimage/pull/21907
